user.title: Set up HA Housekeeper
user.description: Adds the read-only Housekeeper panel for administrators. No cleanup action is executed automatically.

init.title: HA Housekeeper options
init.description: Short outages, for example after a restart, are not reported (0 reports every unavailable entity). Automations that are switched off or never run for the given number of days are reported as unused. Regular scans keep the history and repair hints current.

orphaned_entities.title: {count} orphaned entities
orphaned_entities.description: Housekeeper found {count} entities whose device, integration or state no longer exists. Open Housekeeper in the sidebar to review them. Nothing is changed automatically.

unavailable_entities.title: {count} entities unavailable for a long time
unavailable_entities.description: Housekeeper found {count} entities that have been unavailable longer than the configured threshold. Open Housekeeper in the sidebar to review them. Nothing is changed automatically.

broken_automations.title: {count} findings with missing references
broken_automations.description: Housekeeper found {count} references to entities, devices or areas that no longer exist, in automations, scripts, scenes, dashboards, groups or helpers. Open Housekeeper in the sidebar to review them. Nothing is changed automatically.
